findings.claim: Normal press classifies gameplay UI, begins latched press and clears dragging; only world-origin press arms pan.
findings.strength: Source-proven normal intended ownership; no observed leak
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Need actual callback order, UI hit/latch and same contact lifetime on implicated frame.

findings.claim: Held pan uses shared dragging and delta without explicit !PointerPressedOverUi. Normal press cleared dragging, so only missed ownership/lifecycle or a later writer makes this leak.
findings.strength: Conditional defense seam, not demonstrated normal-path failure
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Show a real UI-origin held sample generating accepted Pan, or label injected post-press flag case synthetic.

findings.claim: Actual card click captures UI sequence and toggles stable group then synchronizes selection. Scrolling relay suppresses click on drag; no direct ground camera recenter or move order here.
findings.strength: Source-proven callback path, actual runtime still unknown
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Check card identity/dragged flag and accepted selection/command buffers. Single aircraft selection may separately enter aircraft focus.

findings.claim: Fullscreen map exit queues perspective lens only, unlike normal ISO exit which explicitly preserves current ground center. Height/pitch changes at fixed XZ can shift ground intersection.
findings.strength: Concrete source asymmetry; desired UX and actual screenshot participation unproven
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Need actual fullscreen entry/exit, before/after ground-center and effective bounds near failure; frame2874mapOpen=false alone does not show earlier transitions.

findings.claim: Aircraft clear applies profile ground lens without a saved manual ground-center or exact prior pose. Ground selection can request this clear.
findings.strength: Concrete source lifecycle, not proof a S002 aircraft focus occurred
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Need actor/session/lens ownership and Applied=true with clear reason before empty view. Do not change aircraft framing or restore policy from screenshot alone.

findings.claim: Public Follow captures actual pre-Follow position/rotation/lens; later restore uses these values, not an arbitrary empty-region lookup.
findings.strength: Source-proven capture; can restore an already-empty prior pose; no cause established
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Need enter/exit/target/restore pose facts plus actual camera pose; cannot infer Follow from sand screenshot.

findings.claim: Ground boundary prefers active map CameraMin/Max, otherwise grid fallback; these are rectangle limits, not a test that visible roads/units occupy every region.
findings.strength: Source-proven limits; actual runtime bounds/geometry unknown
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: Need effective bounds, ground footprint, ground reference plane and render/minimap residency. A valid rectangle does not prove presentation.

findings.claim: ApplyPerspectiveCameraModeInstant changes orthographic flag, Y, rotation/FOV then clamps, without itself restoring prior ground center.
findings.strength: Source-proven mechanism; no numerical real-world displacement asserted
findings.requiredRuntimeEvidence: A separate caller may recenter; inspect full request sequence and actual source elevations, not just this method.

causeVerdict: Unproven. Normal drawer gestures are protected by intended latch; conditional held-pan seam and lens/center restoration hypotheses remain distinct from screenshot evidence.
